wtuynhvnho yvwi ale nahskwo kvwahstawatitohi hi'a nituwehsele'i khilo utulihskehsti akhstawatvhstiyi uwahsv atatayhihehsti ale uwahsv utseli tsutanhawtv ayihskehsti ale akhstawatekehsti

khvnikehsvnho nikvwantvnhele ilaya ale mohsi tsihsanho kvwlhinohehtihske'i
kwitanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsele tsihsa thateyhohvhski ohsiyu ani tsitetoha ale tso'i wtotsilhihtsothvka hsakwo nihi tsatselika hsakwonho mohsi utselika hsakwonho ilaya utselika
vlhaynho yakahthahe iyuwehstiyi utsathiyhenho anihska'ihe'i
ulokilnho unulhvthane'i khnekvnho ulokilv tsunanukotse'i hi'a nikawehske'i hi'a nahski tsikeyu'i akwetsi nahski etsathvtahstahsi
tsunikhso'ahsitihsvnho otalv'i tunetsele nahski khilo uninhonhehtiyi nikehsvna nuhstv unikohv'i khvnhi yvwi uwetsi uyohuhsv tsulehihsanhvhi kehsehsti tuwohsele'i

kvwahthvtvnhen hi'a nuniwehse'i katonho tinwelihski ilaya ikv'yi takaluhtsi tsanatihsko'i'

unetsvnho hi'a nituwehsele'i ilaya utohiyuhi ikvyi uluhihsti ale nikatv uwolhihsohti ale nahskwo hi'a nikvnhvkowhela yvwi uwetsi atsinohehskv'i nahski utsathi tsutalenhvtv uklhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti ale ahsekwo taytsiyelvni
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha ilaya utohiyuhi uluhtsv ale nuhstv unatulihskv nikvwanelv nahski'ya nikvn kowhelv nahski atsinohehskv'i
kvwhstawatitohinho anetohv uluhtsv unitsathi tukohe kvwantalhuwhste'i al tinhowhelihski kvwanathvtvhelhv'ihske'i
tuttvnhenho tinowhelihski kato tetsathvtvhelhv'vhska tuwohsele'i'
unetselvn hi'a nuwehse'i yo nitsohiyuhsvna khohi tsitseha ilako ikohitv itsvyelatitohehsti' ilako ikohitv unelaki itsvylihsehehsti' an hiyathinhoka
unathinhohelenho ukohvnho khilakwo iyvtv atanvhto ukilhvnhe'i elatinho unvtse'i ale tahawo'ihv alitihsvnhihe'i
uttvnhenho utota ilako nikohiki nahski hi'a ikvwalhstanhelvhi' uwohsele'i ayolhikwo kehsv'i utvnhe'i
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsele'i iyunho ketsohiyti kehsehsti nikatiyu kohuhsti ikyekatvnhehti kohiyuhvhski
kilakwonho iyvtv ayolhi utota uwelhunhe'i ale tikvkhsawo'ihi hi'a nuwehse'i tsakvwiyuhi ko'iyuhvhska hskihstelvhsi nakwohiyuhsvna kehsv'i
tsihsanho ukohv nahski unitsathi ananelukihskv anatalhihsihskv'i uhskatse kataha atanvhto hi'a nuwehsele'i tsvkhewa ale titsali'ena atanto kvnetsheha ehinuko'i ale lhehsti nhakwo ilvhiyu tsihiyvlhi
atantonho uwelhunhv ale utsathi ukilhvnhv unukotse'i ale uyohuhsvhikwo nahskiya kehse'i nahski iyuhsti unitsathe ayohuhi anatihske'i
kaltsotenho wi'uyvlhv kvwahstawatitohi unvhsv kehsv kvwattvnhe'i katonho ayv vlha kayotsinukowhihsti yikehse'i' unatvnhe'i
hi'anho nituwehsel'i hi'a nahski iyuhsti vlha yvkyekanukowha khvnhi atatolihsthanvhi ale amalhi kvnhvhi tsikehso'i
unanhikihsvnho nanhani kelili ayelhi unilohse'i vlhanho yutulihske khilo utolehohihstiy
tuweyhonheynho kvwahstawtitohi ale hi'a nituwehsele'i yvwi uwetsi tatsiyohi teketsiyohihsi yvwi ale takvwli ale onhi nhakwo atsilvhi kehsehsti totv'alehihsanhi tso'ine ika

nnhnho tulenhv tsutiyi kata ahv'i uluhtse'i tsotani ahsknititlv tsulohihsthane'i ale unitsathi yvwi thaline ikvwatalhihsanele'i ale iyutvnhehti kehsv nutvnele'i thaline tuweyhonhe'i
anikwalihsinho kvwaluhtshelv kvwahthvtvnhe'i hi'a nuniwehse'i tuyukohtihsko ahskaya uta'invtiyi utali'i' kvwakoliyehske'i
hi'anho nuniwehse'i mohsi ulhskolvhthane kowhelotiyi tokalenvhv'i ale ata'invtiyi
tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nituwehsele'i thstayiyu kehsv iyuhsti titsinawhi hi'a nahski tikhanhwatvhsti itsowlanele'i
titalenihskvhskini uwelhvnhvnv'i unelhanvhi ahskaya ale akeyhv tuwolhvnhe'i
nahski iyuhsti ahskaya tekvhtekehsti utota ale utsi ale utali'i atlawhstihskehsti
nahskinho anithal hsakwokwo kehsehsti unikwetalhv'i nahskinho vlha nhakwo anithali yiki hsakwokwohskini unikwetalhv'i

kalitsotenho aniya'v kvwhstawatitohi thaline ikvwahthvtvnhe nahski ukvwalhi

tunehsvnho ale tuhsihthatv ohstv tunhetsele'i
unikihsvnho kanvnhv wluhtsv khilo iyuhsti uttlho'elvki ale tulhinikwanvnelvki uthvtvnhe hi'a nuwehsele'i hohstv thateyhohvhski kato takatvneli ulhskwatihsti nikehsvna kvnhitv akwatseli iyulhstohtiyi'
tehikhahthaha tikhanhwtvhsti nahski lhehsti tsatayhonelvki lhehsti tsatalhvki lehsti tsanhskihsvki lhehsti kaykoki tshanhohelhvki lhehsti tsatalnuhelhvki tsatota ale tsatsi tehilvkwohtehsti

al khilo nihi nitsatvnhv nukvwiyuhsv iyulhstohtiyi utulihskehsti nahski nikatv kvwanvhsitohi kehsehsti

tsihsanho unhetsv hi'a nuwehsel'i kato tsatuli kvyatvnhehtiyi' tikhewinho hi'a nuwehsel'i tsakvwiyuhi v'akikowhahthvhtiyi akwatuliha
tsihsanho hi'a nuwehsel'i henakwon tsohiyuhsv tsahstelv khilakwono iyvtv kwakowhahthvhti nulhsthane'i ale uhstawatvhse tsihsa a'ihsv'i
unvnhihstiyinho kehsv iyu'i unvhse unvhsitahsti tlokehsi tsunilvwihstanehi tinehv'i nahski tlokehsi tsunilvwhstanehi nvtakvwanehtiyi unehkwotsvhi thelvlati tawhsv'i
ikvwaniyvhenho ale ikvwali'vnhile'i ale ahsvha ikvwanhikihsthane'i
thalinenho nvwatale unvhse'i ale nahski unilhe'i ale unitsathe nvwanatale'i ikatv tanili'vnhihe'i ikatvnho tanihihe'i
ahsenho nahski na tlokehsi tsunilvwhstanehi hi'a nitunatawehsele'i hi'a nahski tsukvwalhohti wuthiyelihihsti kehsv'i kha etiluka tsukvwaltinho uthiyeti ikatselika kehsehsti
kvwaniyvhvnho kvwalhe'i ale thlvlati tawhsv to'ytitlv wikvwata'invhse'i
katonho nahski tvtvneli thelvlati tawhsv utselika' takaluhtsi ale tottvthani nahski tlokehsi tsunilvwhstanehi ale nvwanatale totvnheli thelvlati tawhsv'i

unanelohthanenho kvwaniyvhtiyi ahseno unitsathi yvwi tanihska'ihe'i anikahthaheyhenho unvhsv ketsitvkv nhahski tulhilohsthanv'i ikvwatanv'elenho ale tunenvhse'i

ale hi'a tsinitaniwehseho'i atselhuhki okhvhthanv tetsvnoki'elv ahsenho vlha yitsalihskihsv totsiyvhkvki itsathvkoti ahsenho vlha yititsatloyhilv
nhkwonho ulenvhvki tukvhskolvnvki tunituhv'i nanha uli ika'i uhskwanikohti tulvwhstanelv'i nvtakalhstohtihskvki tunatanvhthv nituninetliyvhsvna kehsv'i
ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha ehskkwo ika'i unikilhiyo'ihsti kehsehsti thaya ale hsatoni tikukhohthohtiyi ik kehsehsti utlihiyu nihi

unelhanvhi utseli atanelv tsuyvlhe'i ale akatohti katu tsuke'i yeli kvwakihsti nikehsvna tsikehse'i ale nahski anehi atsilhskini'anelhohi unvhsv'

ahsenho hi'a nitsvwehseha anhi etoha utli atsilvkwotiyu ehskakwo uthvna tiklawi'ihstiyi

ahsenho hskikyhiyu kehsv nvtikalhstohtiha utli tsiyelvhska kvhstiyetohtiyi kwola uthvhsonhvhi iyakwahsti tsiki al khohi kehsv ayhvki tsihsa kalonetv akhstvtihskv'i
nahski tsuwakthanvhsv nitsahstelihskvna tsikehsvki khohihskini tsiki tsahstelihski ale ayv akhstelihski
nahski thaline vtsinvli nahski iyuhsti nihi tehiyatanilvtsvha nahski akwhsv akinawhi tsiki
ahsenho nihi ohsiyu ntsaylvnhvna vlha yakwatulhe kohuhsti akwatvnhehtiyi nahski ohstv nhskwatvnhehv ohsiyu tsaylvnhv kvnkehsv iyulhstohtiyi vlhanho nahski ahse itsatvnhehtiyi nitsalhstanehv'i
nahskiynho iyuhsti yiki lhek yutanvhsv nahski thiyatanilv'ihsti nikohilv utehtiyi

vtlha nhakwo atsinvhsitahsti nahskiya'i utlihskini kalvkwotiyu ehskakwo atsinvhsitahsti onvlhi akeyuhi nahskiya'i ayv ho ukvwiyuha tsikeyu'i nihihskini nika'v utlihiyu hikeyu'i nahski na ukwetlhi kehsv ale ukvwiyuhi tehstanelhohtv'i'
nahski iyuhsti iyunho okinathkwlohi hskwelihsehehsti tehiyatanilvtsvha ayv tsitehskwatanilvko nahskiya'i
ayv kwola akwhsv akwoyen kvta kowelvka ayv takkuyvhi vlhahskininon tsvhsv kehsv nahskwo kvthuka tihskwatayohihsehtiyi yikvyohseha
tsohiyuhsv akwalhskahstohtv wikvyowelanelvki tsikathahvki nahskwo tsalohsvhstohtiyi kehsv nhatvnehv nuhstv knetsehv'i
ale nahskwo hskwatnv'ihstanelvha hskhskwankotohtiyi uthukiyheno akwvha itsatatolihstihskv iywanhihsohtiyi thalin witsvluhtsehtiyi
maka elihstaka thima luka itsulaha tsokilvwhstanehi
kwola ale thimathi tsihsa kalonet kvwaninvhsitohi wtohstowelahsi nani'v unatanhvhthi kalonet tsihs kwohiyuhi nahski kwilikiyi anehi tohsktlhoyahstiha tinikhahthiya ale aniyathohihi
kvwakthiya utatolihsti kehsv ale nwahthohiyatv itselatitohehsti nvtayunalhskolthane unelhanvhi ikitota ale ukvwiyuhi tsihsa klonetv
akwanelanvhi tsiyali'elitsheho iyuhstiha itsvyanvtatkv'i
nikohilv nkatatolihstihskv nitsithayohihv nihi nitsi'v etsitolihstiyi ulhelihsti akwatanhvthv katatolihstihskv'i
nvtikalhstohtihskv itsahthehkwalohsv ohstv khanohetv tetsikhanhwatihsv'i ikvyiyi ika nvtakvwatalenvtv khohi iyahsthi

nahski tsituyukohti nahski itsvyelihsehtiy nitsi'v'i nvtikalhstohtihskv akinawiyi itsvhskwanikotv'i nahskwoyhenho vkwalhv'it kehsv'i ale tsihstelihskv al tshihstayitihskv ohstv khanohetv nihi nitsi'v itshelatihstiha kvwakahthiya vkitolikv'i
unelanvhiyhenho akwatseli akhahthahi nika'v itsvkyuhsvl'i tsihsa kalonetv utakeyuhti kvtihskv'i
nahski itsikowhahthvhtiyi tsutalenhvtv tutalenha'v'i nahski nitsatlonahstvna itsalhstohtiyi ale nitsatanhahskwalohstihskvna kalonetv utseli ika alhiylolhv kvtihski
nahski itsikhalitsvhi iyulhstohtiyi tuyukohtv kehsv utalenvhi nahski tsihsa kalonetv iywanhihsohtiyi nahski ulvkwhotohtiyi unelhanvhi ale khvnikehsv iywanehtiyi nahsk kalvkwtiyu kehsv'i
ikatv utohiyuhi atvyukehti kehsv ale athsvhsti kehsv unatulihskv nvtikalhstohtiha analtsitohvhska kalonetv aninhoheha ikatvnho nahskwo ohsiyu uniyelvhsv'i

hi'a nahski hsuntaleki kehsv analitsitohvhska kalonetv aninhoheha athsvhstikwo kehsv unatulihskv nvtikalhstohtiha vlhano nntlonahstvna kehsv yanhvhtiha uninhehkwohstiyi uniyelvha tsikiliyokv vkwalhv'itv kehsv'i
anihso'ihskini kkkyuhiyu kehsv nvtikalhstohtiha anikhathahayhenho vkinetselvhi kehsv akhstelhvhtiyi ohstv khanohetv

nahskiya utsathi akwatulihskv ale utuki akwvhsv'i nahski nika'v kohuhsti akwatehohihstiyi nikehsvna nika'vkwohskini nitsihska'ihvna kehsv'i tsinuhstokwo nahskiya nahskwo kohi kalonetv tsilvkwtohti kehsehsti tsiyelv kvhti nahskwo kvnotv kehsv ale akiyohuhihsti kehsv'i
ahsiyhenho yakwalenitolv kalont tsilvkwotohti yakiyohuhsvnho ayv akinehkwotsehti
thalynho iyutaleki kehsv ahstayyu nakwalhstaneha nvtikalhstohti akwatulihskv akwanikihstiyi ale kalonetv tsehv wakwatehtiyi nahski wutkonatthv uli ohsiyu tsiki
nahskino hi'a tsinuhsti tsakwohiyuha tsikathaha akwalenitahstiyi ale nitsi'v itsvyelatitahstiyi nahski itsinehkwotsehtiyi ale itsalihelihstiyi itsohiyuhsv'i
nahski utsathi unhekwotsvhstiyi itsalhelikv tsihsa kalonetv iywanihsatv ayv nvtikalhstohtihskv nahski thaline witsvlutsehti kehsv iyuhsti

nahski iyuhsti iyunho kalonetvyi ukalhsti nvtakvwataleti kehsehsti iyunho atakeyti kehsv atanhuwohihstihski kvwatanhehti kehsehsti iyunho kvthehkwalohti kehsehsti atanvhto vtathinehti kehsv'i iyunho atatolihsti kehsv ale utanvhthi kehsv ehehsti
itsikhalitsa kali'elikv'i ulhoyi iyulhstohtiyi itsatanvhthehskv'i ulhoyikwo iyulhstohtiyi tetsatakeyuhsv'i ulhoykwo iyulhstohtiyi tetsatanhvhthv'i ulhoykwo iyulhstohtiyi titsatanhvhto
lhehsti kohuhsti yitsatvnehehsti athsvhsti kehsv ale ahsekwo atlkwhsti kehsv kvhti elatikwohskini nitetsvnhv tetsatanvhthv itsihsiyvwha utli ntetsilvkwohtehsti anihso'i ehskkwo itsvhsv
lhehsti khilo uwahsvkwo utseli yukhsayhstehsti nani'vhskini anihso'i nahskwo unatselika
nahski hi'a nuhstehsti tetsatanvhthehsti nahskiy nahskwo tsutanthe klonetv tsihsa
nahski tsihsa tuto'v nikatiyu tsunalhinikwanehtiyi nahskwo kalvlo'i anehi ale elohi anehi ale elohi hawintilv anehi
ale nikatiyu tikanka khvnkehsv iyunvneti kehsehsti nahski tsihsa kalonetv ukvwiyuhi kehsv'i kalvkwohtiyu iywanehi kehsehsti unelhanvhi akayvlike'i
nahski iyuhsti itsvkeyu'i nikohilvkwo tsitsohiyuhvhsko'i vlha ayv tsikathhvkwo iyuhsti kohihskini kehsv akikhonelv'i utli ik'i ttsilvwhstahsi etsihstelhvhtiyi kehsv'i itsinayhskv ale tetsinawhskv'i
nahski nahskwo winikalhstoht nihi itsaliheliki ale hskiyalikohvhsi ayv kli'elikv'i
vlhaynho khilo yokinalikoha ulhoyi utanthawateki nahski ahse kvwakhsayhstohti kehsv nitsatvnhatekv'i
ahsenho etsikathha nuhstv nahski atsikoliy'v'i nahski khilo uwetsi utota tsahstelihsko nahskiya akhstelvhitolv ohstv khanohetv ulhiyilvhstiy takilvwhstanehv'i
nahski iyuhsti uthuki akwvha nahski tsinvhstiyi ikvwnvtv katole'ohsvkwo iyakwlhstanehti kehsv'i
ahsenho tsiyalihskahstotiha ukvwiyuhi ulhskolhvhtohtiyi ayv nahskwo akwhsv nikohilvna wtsvluhtsehtiyi
utsathiyhenho utulihskvki itsikowhatvhtiyi nitsi'v'i ale utsahthi kaketv utanthawatekvki nvtakalhstohtihskvki itsathvkanv utlvtsv'i
utohiyuhiyhenho utlvkvki ale alekwo nuyohuhsvki ahsenho unelhanvhi uwetolitsvki vlha ale nahskikwo uwahsv ayvhskini nahskwo nahski ulohsilotv uyo akwatanthatihstiyi nikehsvna
ulhskwalthinho kehsv italhinvtli itsalheliki ukvwiyuhi kehsv iyuhsti hi'a nhski witsvyowelanehtiyi utohiyuhi vlha tsuyawe'ihsti ykiyelvha ayv nihihskini unayehihsti kehsv itsutalehski
tetseyhahthotsehehsti kilhi tetseyhahthotsehehsti uyo tsunilvwhstanehi tetseyhahthotsehehsti tinihuhstehski
ayvyhenho tsek'uhstehselvhi unelhanvhi atanvhto kvhti etatatolihstanehi tsiki ale italiheliki kalonetv tsihsa etalihskahstohtv iyuhsti ale ukwetalhi kehsv nikalhskahstohtvna tsiki
ahseno nika'v nahski kvkwalhstelhvhtohti akiylvnhv'i nahski ehskkwo iyakwnehi akiyelvha kalonetv nvtakalhstota

ale nahski tetsiyanelhohtv vkwathvhtiyi akwatutalehstohti akwvhsv akwatseli nakihvna kehsv'i nahski tikhanhawtvhsti kvwatanhehti tsiki nahskini kalonet kohihyti kehsv tsvtitalehvhska nahski atutalehstohti kehsv unelhanvhi nvtayutalenhvhi tsiki nahski kohihyti kehsv khvhtohti tsiki
nahski tsikatho'vhihstiyi ale ulhiniktiyu kehsv nahski uyohuhsv tulehihsanhv'i ale akwltihstihskv nahski ukilhiyotsitolv'i ale uyohuhsv nahskiya akiyohuhihstiy

vlhahskininon kayula tsitakiniyvhso nahskiya yakiyelvha vlha ale akhskwatvhi kayula yakiyelvha tsihstawatekahskini iyu yeli yki nahski tikiniyhvhtiyi nahski nahskwo ukvwalhi kalonetv tsihsa tsitakiniyvhvki
tikethv itilv tkalihskwaliha ahsahstv tikiniyvhtiyi nahski unelhanvhi kalvlati nvtayutalenhvhi atayhahntohti kehsv kalonetv tsihsa akvtihskv'i
nahski iyuhsti ayv niti'v ikihskwatvhi kehsv'i nahski nuhstehsti ikatanhvhthehsti ale iyu kohuhsti kehsv nvwatal nuhstehsti totsatanthehsti unelanvhi nahski hi'a nahskwo kvnikehsv nvtatsvnheli
italhinvtli itsathehkwalohi hskihstawateki kehsehsti ale tetsakhsayhstehsti nahski iyanatvnehi anetohv'i nahski ayv hskiyatelohkwa'ehi tsitehskiyakhaha
unitsathayhenho anetoha nahski uwakhuhthilotv katsine'ihsthanvhi itsvnonhelvhi ale khohi kehsv nahskwo tikakatloyihi itsvnonheha nahski anihskaki kehsv tsutanhawatv kalontv utselika
nahski unihskwatihstohti kehsv atathvhtihski tsiki unanelhanvhi unihskwolhiyikwo tsiki ale unatehohihstihskikwo anatlvkwhstihski tsiki nahski elohikwo ehi unakhsayhsti tsiki
ayvyhenho kalvlati itehi nanha nahskwo nvtayulohihstiyi tsitikhahthenhoha ikihstelihski nahski ukvwiyuhi tsihsa klonetv

nahski tikintliyv'ehti tsiki nitikalvkwohtvna titiyelv'i nahskiya itsuwanetiyi uwahsv kalvkwtiyu ayelv nuhstv'i nahskiya ulhinikvkv khvhtihskv nikatiyu tsutalenhvtv uwahsv tikvwanelhohtohtiyi iywanhehtiyi
nahski iyuhsti italhinvtli itsvkeyu'i ale utsathi itsvyanvthi hskiyal'elihstihski ale akwalhstulotohti nvwhstehsti ulhinikt tetsitokehsti ukvwiyuhi etsalihskahstohtv'i itsvkeyu'i

ale kvhstiyetiha nahskwo nihi nitsatlonahstvna kvkinahthkwalohi kvkhstelhvhtiyi na anikeyhv kvkhstelvhitolvhi takilvwhstanelv kalitsitonhitohv ohstv khanohetv hiyalhoyahsthanvha nahskwo tlmina ale anihso'i utlhoyi tsokilvwhstanehi nahski tunato'v tsitekowhela kvnhitv atanhehi kowhelihi
itsalihelikehsti nikohilv ukvwiyuhi nvtikalhstohtihskehsti itsalihelikehsti katiha thaline
lhehsti kohuhsti yitselihihskehsti nutalehsvhskini kohuhsti atatolihstohti ale athayohsti kehsv kvhti alihelihsti kwaltlhoyahsti khvnkehsv netsvnhehehsti unelhanvhi nuhstv itsatulihskv'i

nahski ktalenhvtv hskiyatelohkwa'elvhi kehsv'i ale tihskiyatanilvtselvhi kehsv'i ale hskiyatkanelvhi kehsv'i ale hskiko'elvhi kehsv'i nitsatvnehehsti unelhanvhinho nvwahtohiytv atanhehi titsikhanhawatitahsti kehsehsti
ahsenho ukvwiyuhi utsathi tsiyali'elitsvki nahski nhakwo uwohitsvhi hskiyanvthv thaline atsehiyoki nahski nanha ukvwalhi nahskwo hskiyanvthvki ahsenho vlha yitsatlanvtatehe'i
vlha atina akinhikvhsehv tsine'ihstihskv yiki akwatelhohkwa'vyhenho nika'v nakwalhstanhelitekv ohsiyukwo akiyelhvhtiyi

tsikathaha iyakwatvnhehtiyi elati yinakwatvnhateka al tsikathaha iyakwatvnhehtiyi utsathi yakiha nika'v tekehsatihsv'i al nika'v nakwalhstanelitekv'i vkwyhonhv iykwatvnehtiyi nahskwo yakwolhanv ale nahskwo yakiyohsiha nahskwo utsathi yakiha ale nahskwo ykhinikvhseha
nika'vkwo ikvkwatvneti kalonetv iywanhihsatv nahski tskwalhinikohihstiha
ahsehskininonv ohsiyu nitsatvnelv tsihskinelv akwalhstelhvhtohti tsikiliyokv iyu'i

nahskino nihi kwlikiyi itsehi itsikahthahehsti nahskwo nahski ohstv khanohetv ikvyiyi itsvyltsitonhelv nahiyu mahsitoni akwanhikihsv vlha ilvhitlv unatalhuhkv tsunanelhohti kohuhsti yikvkwatvnhele nahski atanhehti ale vtathinehti kehsv ukvwalhi nihi itsvhsv
tehsilonikyhenho wketohv hsakwo nitsatanvhsvki akinikvhsehv akwalhstelhvhtohti ale nahskwo thaline'i
ahsenho akwanelhanvhi itsinehti kehsehsti nika'v itsinikvhsehv'i nahskiya uwnha'iyu ale kalvkwotiyu kehsv'i kalonetv tsihsa iywanhihsatv
nhakwonho unelhanvhi ale ikitota kalvkwohtohti kehsehsti nikohilv ale nikohilv'i emenv
tetsiyolha nani'v unatanthi kalonetv tsihsa anohiyuhvhski otsalhinvtli anhi tsotsetoha wiketsiyoliha
nani'v unatanhvthi wketsiyoliha ho ukvwiyuha nahski na hsihs tutathinha'v'i

ayv kwola unelanvhi akinvhsitohi ale tsihsa kalonetv akinvhsitv nahskiya unohiyuhsv unelhanvhi tsuhsuyetv al nahskiya titanilv'ihsti kehsv tuyukohtv kehsv'i nahski unelhanvhi kanayehihsti kehsv nahskiya tsiki
ahsenho nahiyu ahselhvhi kehsv kvnikehsv nuwanele utsel khanohetv uwvhthane alhitsitohti kehsv'i nahski ayv vkwakhenvtvhi tsiki nahskiya unhetsv unelhanvhi ikihstelihski
hi'a nvtakalhstohtihskvki lhitiyi tsvtakvyakhhiyvki nahski ohstv itsvnelitahstiyi nahski tsutalenhvtv unhohsvnhv'i ale thikhohtiyi tikekanelhohti tkatuwhatihsv'i nahskiya itsatvnhehtiyi kvnetselv'i
utahskwanikotohtiyihskini ohsiyu uyelvhi ohstv kehsv ukeyuhi uyhvhstehski nikehsvna tuyukohtv iyatvnehi nahskanhvna ulhsinahsti

ahstaya tsuniyvhi nutalitahstvna khanohetv nahskiya akeyonhv'i nahski ntayulhstohtiyi yelikwo tikvwawonhehtohti ohstv titeyohti kehsv kvhtihskv'i ale kvwantohiyunanehti ikwanhehti tinikhahthileki kehsv'i
nahski tiniholi ahse tketsihstunehti nahski nani'v hsitanelvhi anehi tinikthahvhski nahski tsitanateyhohvhska nituyukhohthvna tsiki tsunateyhohtiyi tsukvwalti kataha unik'vhskv iyuhsti
nunakhsayhstvnakwo iyulhstohtiyi anitsuhsi unnhelhvti kehsv'i ale yvwikwo nahski tuyukohtv kehsv tinikolhski uninhetsvhi

nahski na unatanvkalvtv kehsv'i nikatiyu tsutalenvtv unatanvkalv'elvhi kehso'i nahskihskini na kataha iyunalhsthanvhi ale nunohiyuhsvna vlha kohuhsti unatanvkalv'elvhi yikehso'i nahskwohskini tunatanvhthv ale tsunukhohtohtiyi kataha itikvnelvhi
nihihskini hinohehskehsti nahski ohstv titeyhohti kehsv ulilohvhski
nahski tsunathvhsonhvhi tsuniyhstehski nikehsvna iyunalhstohtiyi ketsilvkwoti unalhsinahihsti nukolvna kehsv unohiyuhsv'i ale unatakeyuhsv'i ale tinvnhitiyu kehsv'i

anikeyhv nahskwo anikayvlike'i nahski tunilvwhstanehv tuyukohtv iyatvnehti kehsv ulilohvhski yiki uhsonv anatanhohehski nikehsvna kikake'atithahsti unikanahsihski nikehsvna ohstv kehsv tinateyhohvhski
nahski tikvwaneyhohti yiki aniwinakehsani anikeyhv unalhsinahihsti iyulhstohtiyi tsunikeyuhi iyulhstohtiyi tikvwaniyhehi tsunikeyuhi iyulhstohtiyi tsunetsi
aniwin nahskwo thinetsehehsti unalhsinahihsti iyunalhstohtiyi
hiwonihskv ohstv yiki nahski kkhonelohihsti nikehsvna nahski na tsatlutihski kvwatehohihsti yiki nuhvnv kehsv iyuhsti kohuhsti uhsonv lhonohehtiyi
ketsinvhsitahsti tehinetsehehsti tsunohiyuhtiyi unvhs tikvwaninvhsitohi nika'vkwo nanatvnehv ohstv uniyelhvhti tsunilvwhstantiyi thalinekwo nvtninekvna
kvwakahthiyayhenho utatolihsti kehsv unelhanvhi nahski atahstelihski nani'v yvwi uninanukotselv

ikeyhvhska nahski itatayhihv unelhanvhi tinelhohtohti nikehsvna kehsv'i ale elohi ehi atulvnhvti kehsv'i ikalhsinahihsti ale tuyukhohtv'i ale unelhanvhi kalvkwohtohti kehsv yitalenhitoha anhi elohi kehsv'i
yitikhahthiya ohstv utuki kvti kehsv'i nahski kalvkwotiyu nutvnhehsti kanankotsilhv kalvkwohti unelhanvhi ale ikihstelihski tsihsa kalonetv
khilo uhsonv uninohehtiyi nikehsvna tsunathiyohsathi nikehsvna iyunalhstohtiyi unatanhvhthihskini iyunalhstohtiyi khvnikehsv iyunvnehtiyi nani'vkwo anikhahthahv utsathi unatanthiyu kehsv'i

ikvhsvyhenho nahskwo ilvhiyu tsikehsv ikineku kehsvki nikohiyuhsvna ikilitahsthanhvhi kohuhsti tetatvnhehvki tsutalenhvtv atulvnhvti kehsv ale ohstv atatanvtatihstihski kehsv'i uyo kehsv ale atvhyukehti itehvki ikinikwathihsti ale titatankwathihi kehsvki
nahski kvwakahthiya utatolihsti kehsv tikatutalehsthanvhi kehsv'i nahski nahskiya ulhskwatihsti nikehsvna kvnhitv ikatseli iyulhstohtiyi nahskiya uthuki ikvhsv'i
khilo tikalenvhtihski hsakwo ale thali iyakeyhahthanvhi kehsehsti etsiyo'ihselvha
iyunho athima tsinvhsvha witsluhtsehtiyi ale tikika halhinikvnelvha nakokwali hskiluhtsehtiyi nanhayhenho takwkhohthanv akwkolatiyvhtiyi
ale nahskwo tikatselika wantelhohkwa nikohilv ohstv tsunilvwhstantiyi nahski utulhvhti nikalhstihskv kohuhsti kvhthanitahsti nahski aninehkwohski iyunalhstohtiyi
